rationale: The failing operation is importing a shared texture from an offscreen paint handler across an asynchronous boundary. offscreen directly identifies it; webcontents is a defensible event-owner label. app, V8, Node and GPU names in the stack or speculation do not establish those components as the fault. The substantial handler is not a complete launchable app and its real asynchronous publisher/trigger is absent, so requesting an isolated Fiddle is useful; accepting the detailed diagnostic snippet as enough for initial investigation is also defensible. #50247 describes stale-renderer IPC/background-operation failure in v8::String::Value, a different operation from CFRetain during shared-texture import despite SIGTRAP on ARM64.
